specification.title: One justified replan is authorized and honored
specification.description: NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE authorizes exactly one additional round then sufficient.
specification.purpose: Verify a NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE disposition authorizes exactly one additional planning round and the investigation then terminates.
specification.operational_relevance: Replanning is the coordinator's bounded mechanism to react to new knowledge; a single justified round is the expected real behavior.
specification.regression_risk: The coordinator could refuse the justified replan or loop beyond the replan allowance.

required: The requested replan round executes within the declared allowance
The investigation stops with sufficient_evidence after one replan
forbidden: More replans are executed than the declared maximum
